## ApprovalRequestContext.signal property

Aborted when the bound in [ApprovalRequest.timeoutMs](./core.approvalrequest.timeoutms.md) elapses. Providers should use it to cancel network waits and retract any prompt they raised — macts has already stopped waiting and denied the call by then.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly signal: AbortSignal;
```
